title: What services does Capex Engineering offer end-to-end?
body: We deliver turnkey HVAC, VRV, clean rooms, fire fighting, MEP, underground HT/LT electrical, City Gas Distribution and 33/11 kV sub-station construction — all under one accountable contract covering supply, installation, testing and commissioning.

title: Which regions do you operate in?
body: Our corporate office is in Noida with a branch office in Patna, Bihar. We execute projects pan-India, with active deployments across UP, Delhi-NCR, Bihar, Maharashtra and other states.

title: Do you provide post-installation maintenance?
body: Yes. We offer AMCs backed by written Service Level Agreements, a documented escalation matrix, skilled operators and log-book based performance tracking.

title: Are you empanelled with major consultants and PMCs?
body: We are associated with leading Delhi-NCR architects and PMCs including JLL, CBRE, Knight Frank, ISA Projects, Hexagramme, UDC Interiors and others.
